To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the atropisomerization of 1-(3-pentyl) cyclohepta[b]-pyrrol-3(1H)-ones is governed by the steric interactions of the alkyl chain with the pyrrole ring, and that the rotational barriers for this process are in the range 86-93 kJ/mol.
The 1H N-MR spectra of the two atropisomers were measured in the range from −80 to +60°C in CDCl3, CD2Cl2 and C6D6.
The rotational barrier of 86.8 kJ/mol at 25 °C in CDCl3 for the C-N bond atropism of 1- (2,4-dimetil-3-pentil)-ciclohepta[b]-pirrol-2(2H)-one was measured.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of 1-(3-alkyl-2,4-dipentyl)-2H-pyrrol-2-ones, which were prepared from 2,4-dibromopentane, 3-alkylpyrroles, and sodium hydride.
the synthesis of 1-(3-methylbut-3-enyl)cyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid, which is the key intermediate in the synthesis of cyclohepta[b]- and -[c]pyrrolone.
the synthesis and characterization of the novel atropisomer of 1-(pentan-2-yl)cyclohexa[b]pyrrole.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the atropisomer of 1-(3-pentyl-2,4-dipentyl)cyclopenta[b]pyrrole is not formed in the reaction mixture of the cyclopentadiene and 1,5-dibromo-3-pentanone, which is in contrast to the reaction of cyclopentadienyl anion with the same ketone.
the atropisomerization of 1-(3-methylpentyl)indan-2-one is a two-step process with a first step of 1H-1,3-shift, and the second step of 1,3-H-shift.

the C-N bond atropism of the 3-pentylcycloheptapyrrol-2-one is not a result of the conformational effect of the alkyl side-chain but of the intramolecular hydrogen bonding of the 2-hydrogen atom with the carbonyl group.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new atropisomer, which is the second example of the atropisomer of the cyclohepta(b)-pyrrol-ones, was found and the rotational barrier of the new atropisomers was determined.

the C-N bond atropism of 1,2-disubstituted cyclohept[b]pyrroles is controlled by the substituents on the pyrroline ring, which is in accordance with the results obtained from the cyclohept[a]indene series.
the rotational barrier of the C-N atropisomer of 1-(1,3-dimethylpentyl)cyclohexane is 86.8 ± 0.5 kJ/mol at room temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the rotational barrier of a 1-(2-methyl-3-pentanyl)pyrrolidine is 2.5 kJ/mol higher than that of the 1-(2-pentanyl)pyridine.
the C-N bond atropiomerism of the cyclohepta[b]-pyrrolone system is controlled by the steric hindrance of the substituents at C(2) and C(4).
the C-N bond atropism is the key factor in determining the rotational barriers of the cyclohepta[b]-pyrrol-1-ones.
